CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is a good way to blend the edges of two tones? (1 mark)
   A. With a knife
   B. With sand
   C. With a damp brush
   D. With a dry stone

2. Sportsmanship means (1 mark)
   A. being fair and kind in sports
   B. teasing others
   C. cheating to win
   D. hitting

3. Which material can you use to make a portfolio? (1 mark)
   A. Iron sheets
   B. Sand
   C. Manila paper or cardboard
   D. Glass

4. How far apart are the hands placed at the start? (1 mark)
   A. One on each side of the track
   B. Shoulder-width apart
   C. As far as possible
   D. Touching each other

5. A player who catches the ball must not (1 mark)
   A. throw it to a teammate
   B. run with it
   C. pass it
   D. pivot on the landing foot

6. The flash is (1 mark)
   A. a small light for dark places
   B. the strap
   C. the button
   D. the screen

7. Overlapping in a montage means (1 mark)
   A. pieces are cut into tiny bits
   B. pieces are far apart
   C. one piece partly covers another
   D. pieces are painted black

8. Two stars and a wish means (1 mark)
   A. two mistakes and a prize
   B. two songs and a wish
   C. two good comments and one suggestion
   D. two lines and a circle

9. Which is a good ratio of length to height for a flag drawing? (1 mark)
   A. Three to two
   B. Two to three tall
   C. Ten to one
   D. One to one

10. A value scale strip shows (1 mark)
   A. only black paint
   B. only primary colours
   C. a picture of a mountain
   D. steps from light to dark of one colour

11. On the Kenyan flag, green stands for (1 mark)
   A. the sun
   B. the people
   C. the rivers only
   D. the land and natural wealth

12. Why is a pattern with only taa taa taa taa dull? (1 mark)
   A. It has no beat
   B. It is too long
   C. It has too many rests
   D. It has no variation of note values

13. The first step of tying an overhand knot is to (1 mark)
   A. cut the cord
   B. make a loop
   C. wet the cord
   D. burn the cord

14. In a crab balance, what is a common mistake? (1 mark)
   A. Head in line
   B. Hips sagging near the mat
   C. Hips lifted
   D. Straight arms

15. Tempo means (1 mark)
   A. the speed of the music
   B. the name of the song
   C. how loud the music is
   D. the number of verses

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Explain how to analyse a folk song performance using its components. (5 marks)

17. Name two parts of a drum. (2 marks)

18. State the recorder notes that match d, r and m. (3 marks)

19. Why do we use a streamlined shape when gliding? (2 marks)

20. What is the East African Community? (3 marks)
pages.answers:
CREATIVE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — With a damp brush
   A damp brush joins the tones smoothly.

2. A — being fair and kind in sports
   It includes following rules and respecting others.

3. C — Manila paper or cardboard
   Manila paper folds easily.

4. B — Shoulder-width apart
   Hands are about shoulder-width apart.

5. B — run with it
   Running with the ball is against the rules.

6. A — a small light for dark places
   The flash gives extra light.

7. C — one piece partly covers another
   Overlapping helps to fill gaps and make the montage full.

8. C — two good comments and one suggestion
   Give two positives and one idea to improve.

9. A — Three to two
   A flag rectangle is about one and a half times as long as it is high.

10. D — steps from light to dark of one colour
   A scale strip shows one colour changing from light to dark.

11. D — the land and natural wealth
   Green stands for the land and its natural wealth.

12. D — It has no variation of note values
   A good pattern mixes different note values.

13. B — make a loop
   You make a loop first, pass the end through it and pull tight.

14. B — Hips sagging near the mat
   Hips should stay lifted to make the body level.

15. A — the speed of the music
   Tempo is how fast or slow.

SECTION B
----
16. (5 marks)
   Answer: Say the community of origin, the type or occasion, the message and mood, the roles of the soloist, chorus and instrumentalists, and the instruments used.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of five components.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: Drumhead (skin) and shell (body). Rope and beater are also accepted.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct part.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: If G is doh, then G, A and B match d, r and m. G is d, A is r and B is m.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: A long, thin shape slips through the water easily, so you glide further.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each.

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: A group of countries in East Africa that work together on matters such as trade, travel and peace.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for group of countries, 1 mark for East Africa, 1 mark for working together.
